label: Mapster
description: Faster, lighter alternative to AutoMapper with compile-time code generation available. Config lives in IRegister classes.
$comment: The crud_* vars are consumed by orm/efcore's CrudService.cs template. All three mapping fragments must define the SAME keys — erb throws on a missing path, and "" is falsy, which is how the template skips a block.

vars.name: Mapster
quality_checks: Reads use `ProjectToType<TDto>()` rather than loading a collection of entities and mapping it in memory

commands.run: dotnet add src/<% project.pascal %>.Api package Mapster
